title: Weave Router: a drop-in proxy that picks the right model per request, with a tiny on-box embedder
description:
If you're running agents, you fire every request at one expensive model, even the trivial ones, and burn money. Weave Router is a drop-in proxy that picks the right model per request, with a tiny on-box embedder, not vibes. Point Claude Code or Cursor at it, speak any provider's API, and your keys stay encrypted on your box. The team clocks routing under 50 milliseconds and claims 40 to 70% lower costs. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/workweave/router
